settings.heading: Energy that doesn't crash.
settings.subline: Two chewables a day, sealed one dose at a time. NR, PQQ and CoQ10 work inside your mitochondria — so you make energy instead of borrowing it from tomorrow.

settings.heading: By 50, your NAD+ is roughly half what it was at 20.
settings.body: NAD+ is the coenzyme your mitochondria use to turn food into usable energy, and the one your cells use for DNA repair. Levels fall steadily with age. That decline is the reason lockin leads with NR rather than a stimulant.

settings.title: Repair

settings.title: Full strength on day 30
settings.text: Each dose is sealed on its own, so nothing oxidises until you tear it.

settings.title: No counting, no rattle
settings.text: One foil is the whole dose. Two chewables inside — that is it.

settings.title: Fits where a bottle doesn't
settings.text: A bag, a car door, a jacket pocket. The dose travels with you.

settings.heading: Dose thirty as strong as dose one.
settings.body: NR and vitamin C degrade on contact with air. In an opened bottle, every time you take the lid off, what is left inside gets a little weaker. By the end of the month you are taking a different product than the one you bought.

settings.heading: Start with a month.
settings.body: Two chewables in the morning. No water, no caffeine, no 3pm drop. If it is not for you, say so and we will make it right.
